title: Check actual available memory on Linux
summary: Linux uses RAM for caching to speed up performance. This command shows the difference between 'free' memory and 'available' memory, helping you understand why RAM usage looks high.

aliases.text: why is arch using all my ram
почему арх использует всю оперативную память

steps.explain: Run the free command with human-readable output. Look at the 'available' column in the 'Mem' row, not just 'free'.
steps.expect: Output shows total, used, free, shared, buff/cache, and available memory. 'Available' is the memory actually free for new applications.
